ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EXISTING_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION check_existing_data RETURN boolean IS
 v_grade VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.grade));
 v_a1 VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.a1));
 v_a2 VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.a2));
 v_b1 VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.b1));
 v_b2 VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.b2));
BEGIN
 If NVL(:valid_hla_grading.grade,'') = NVL(v_grade,'') AND
 NVL(:valid_hla_grading.a1,'') = NVL(v_a1,'') AND
 NVL(:valid_hla_grading.a2,'') = NVL(v_a2,'') AND
 NVL(:valid_hla_grading.b1,'') = NVL(v_b1,'') AND
 NVL(:valid_hla_grading.b2,'') = NVL(v_b2,'') 
 Then
 return (TRUE);
 Else
 return (False);
 End if; 

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DB_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION db_check (plGrade in varchar2,plA1 in varchar2, plA2 in VARCHAR2,
 plB1 in varchar2,plB2 in varchar2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 vCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN

 select nvl(count(*),0) into vCount from valid_hla_grading where
 grade = plGrade and A1 = plA1 and A2 = plA2 and B1 = plB1 and B2 = plB2;

 IF vCount > 0 then 
 RETURN (TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN (FALSE);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_DELETE_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_delete_rg(plGrade in varchar2,plA1 in varchar2, plA2 in varchar2,
 plB1 in varchar2,plB2 in varchar2) IS
 rg_name VARCHAR2(20) := 'HLAGR'; 
 rg_col1 VARCHAR2(20) := 'HLAGR.grade'; 
 rg_col2 VARCHAR2(20) := 'HLAGR.A1';
 rg_col3 VARCHAR2(20) := 'HLAGR.A2'; 
 rg_col4 VARCHAR2(20) := 'HLAGR.B1'; 
 rg_col5 VARCHAR2(20) := 'HLAGR.B2'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 rowcount NUMBER; 
BEGIN 
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rowcount:=GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('HLAGR');
 --message(to_char(rowcount));pause;
 For i in 1.. rowcount Loop
 If Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col1,i) = plGrade AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col2,i) = plA1 AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col3,i) = plA2 AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col4,i) = plB1 AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col5,i) = plB2 
 Then
 delete_group_row(rg_id,i);
 exit;
 End if;
 End Loop;
 END IF; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_INSERT_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_insert_rg(plGrade in varchar2,plA1 in varchar2, plA2 in varchar2,
 plB1 in varchar2,plB2 in varchar2) IS

 rg_name VARCHAR2(20) := 'HLAGR'; 
 rg_col1 VARCHAR2(20) := 'HLAGR.grade'; 
 rg_col2 VARCHAR2(20) := 'HLAGR.A1';
 rg_col3 VARCHAR2(20) := 'HLAGR.A2'; 
 rg_col4 VARCHAR2(20) := 'HLAGR.B1'; 
 rg_col5 VARCHAR2(20) := 'HLAGR.B2'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 

 rowcount NUMBER; 
 DUP_RECORD VARCHAR2(1):='N';
 VCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN 
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rowcount:=GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('HLAGR');
 FOR i in 1 .. rowcount Loop
 If Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col1,i) = plGrade AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col2,i) = plA1 AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col3,i) = plA2 AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col4,i) = plB1 AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col5,i) = plB2
 Then
 DUP_RECORD:='Y'; 
 exit;
 End if; 
 End Loop;

 If DUP_RECORD ='Y' then 
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else

 Add_Group_Row( rg_id, END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col1, rowcount+1, plGrade); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col2, rowcount+1, plA1); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col3, rowcount+1, plA2); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col4, rowcount+1, plB1); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col5, rowcount+1, plB2); 
 End if;
 END IF; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_REC_VALIDATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_rec_validation IS
 v_Grade VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.grade));
 v_A1 VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.A1));
 v_A2 VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.A2));
 v_B1 VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.B1));
 v_B2 VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.B2));

BEGIN

 If :valid_hla_grading.grade is not null and :valid_hla_grading.A1 is not null and 
 :valid_hla_grading.A2 is not null and :valid_hla_grading.B1 is not null and 
 :valid_hla_grading.B2 is not null 
 Then 
 If not check_existing_data then
 If db_check(:valid_hla_grading.grade,:valid_hla_grading.A1,:valid_hla_grading.A2,
 :valid_hla_grading.B1,:valid_hla_grading.B2)
 Then
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else
 
 If NVL(:valid_hla_grading.grade,' ') !=NVL(v_grade,' ') OR
 NVL(:valid_hla_grading.A1,' ') !=NVL(v_A1,' ') OR
 NVL(:valid_hla_grading.A2,' ') !=NVL(v_A2,' ') OR
 NVL(:valid_hla_grading.B1,' ') !=NVL(v_B1,' ') OR
 NVL(:valid_hla_grading.B2,' ') !=NVL(v_B2,' ') 
 Then 
 -- message(v_grade||' A1='||v_A1||' A2='||v_A2||' B1='||v_B1||' B2='||v_B2);pause;
 -- if you are overwritng , the background data must be deleted, so delete

 if v_grade is not null and v_A1 is not null and v_A2 is not null and v_B1 is not null and
 v_B2 is not null then
 DUP_DELETE_RG(v_grade,v_A1,v_A2,v_B1,v_B2);
 end if;
 
 End if; 
 DUP_INSERT_RG(:valid_hla_grading.grade,:valid_hla_grading.A1,:valid_hla_grading.A2,:valid_hla_grading.B1,
 :valid_hla_grading.B2); 
 End if; 
 End if;
End if;
END;
